name: v2ray-auto-desktop
description: V2Ray Auto desktop client (Electron + Python sidecar)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:renderer && npm run setup:backend
scripts.build:backend: runtime/python3.13/bin/python3 -m PyInstaller --onefile --name v2ray-backend --paths .. --hidden-import simple_websocket --hidden-import engineio.async_drivers.threading --distpath backend/dist --workpath build/pyi-work --specpath build/pyi-spec --clean backend/launcher.py
scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:renderer && cross-env-shell ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && cross-env-shell ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:renderer && cross-env-shell ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux --publish never
